# n8n-to-fastify

> Ahead-Of-Time (AOT) compiler that transpiles visual n8n workflow JSON exports (including nested subworkflows) into standalone, bare-metal TypeScript/Fastify microservices with zero runtime interpreter overhead.

## Links

- Repository: https://github.com/rogeriomaciel/n8n-to-fastify
- Official Landing Page & Live Playground: https://rogeriomaciel.com.br/en/n8n-to-fastify/
- GitHub Pages Playground: https://rogeriomaciel.github.io/n8n-to-fastify/
- Releases: https://github.com/rogeriomaciel/n8n-to-fastify/releases
- Documentation (README): https://github.com/rogeriomaciel/n8n-to-fastify/blob/main/README.md

## Core Capabilities

- **In-Memory Subworkflow Transpilation**: Compiles directories of workflows into a `WorkflowRegistry` where `Execute Workflow` compiles to direct async TypeScript function calls (< 0.05ms, zero HTTP hops).
- **Strict Compatibility & DAG Validation**: `--strict` flag reports unsupported node types/options and detects cyclic dependencies at build time (while supporting bounded single-entry polling loops via `N8N_TO_FASTIFY_POLL_MAX_ATTEMPTS`).
- **Per-Item Routing & Reconvergence**: Deterministic per-item branching for `IF` and `Switch` (rules and expression modes), positional `Merge` across up to 10 ports, and `runNodeBatches` for reconverging paths.
- **Production Node Support**: Webhooks (with redacted 500 error IDs), `Code` (`$env`, `--dependencies`, `continueRegularOutput`, `isExecuted`, `$items()`, legacy `$node` bindings), `Set / Edit Fields` (v3.4 JSON Output + binary preservation + prototype-pollution guards), `HTTP Request` (JSON + multipart binary, timeouts, retries, `Never Error`, `$node` bindings), `RabbitMQ` (exchange publisher + post-success ack trigger with graceful drain), `Postgres Trigger` (`LISTEN`/`NOTIFY` with reconnect & graceful drain), `S3` v1 downloads (with retry), `Convert to File` (JSON), `Compression` (ZIP/GZIP decompression with anti-Zip-Bomb and anti-Zip-Slip guards), `No Operation`, `Wait` (dynamic runtime intervals), `Stop and Error`, `PostgreSQL`, and `OpenAI / Anthropic Claude / Google Gemini / Groq LLM`.
- **Observability**: Opt-in structured JSON node execution traces (`N8N_TO_FASTIFY_TRACE=1`) without payload or error leakage.

## Source Entrypoints

- CLI: `bin/cli.ts`
- Parser & Polling Analysis: `src/compiler/core-parser.ts`, `src/compiler/parser.ts`, `src/compiler/polling-loops.ts`, `src/compiler/compatibility.ts`
- Code & Route Generation: `src/compiler/code-generator.ts`, `src/compiler/route-generator.ts`, `src/compiler/expression-parser.ts`, `src/compiler/mappers/index.ts`
- Runtime Primitives: `src/runtime/workflow-context.ts`, `src/runtime/workflow-registry.ts`, `src/runtime/workflow-trace.ts`, `src/runtime/rabbitmq.ts`, `src/runtime/s3.ts`, `src/runtime/compression.ts`
